decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures the high-speed splash constraint and all expressly accepted mitigation options; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The same-message MODIFY already records the approved 3000 RPM maximum, adjustable range, and slow-mixing and higher-speed-frothing modes.
The existing same-message Event already records that the motors must not be operated constantly at maximum speed; the smooth high-speed mixing constraint adds no durability-state change.
The client only permits bowl-depth adjustment if necessary as a possible mitigation and does not select a new bowl depth, capacity, or geometry.
The same-message MODIFY already replaces the prior motor constraint with the approved adjustable 3000 RPM motor selection; the performance constraint does not require another BOM update.
Possible adjustment of whisk position or bowl depth for clean high-speed operation does not change the requirement that bowls be quickly removable and swappable.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records CAD accommodation of the approved larger 3000 RPM motors; no further layout change is necessarily entailed.
The source constrains mixing smoothness and splash behavior at higher motor speeds but does not alter the dispensing mechanism, sequence, flow, or post-close behavior.
The source does not mandate a new enclosure size or form factor; bowl-depth adjustment is presented only as a conditional mitigation option.
High-speed mixing behavior and optional splash mitigation do not change the dispensing path's removability or cleaning requirements.
The source addresses splashing and mixing aggressiveness, not plumbing seals or leak prevention, so the candidate remains valid unchanged.
The approved high-speed mixing direction has no effect on placard text, position, or customer-facing orientation.
